357.content:
The snapshot's version: `<date>+<commit>+<digest>` — the date (UTC) and 40-digit commit of LiteLLM's
`model_prices_and_context_window.json` it was generated from, then 12 hex digits digesting the prices themselves
(the SHA-256 of their deterministic JSON, computed by `scripts/update-pricing.ts`); the date is that commit's, not
the day the snapshot was generated. The version changes whenever the table's content changes, even under the same
LiteLLM commit, so a host that records it next to the costs it computes with `litellmPrices` can tell when stored
data would be priced differently and recompute.

397.content: The price lookup over `table`. Keys match regardless of case.

398.content:
Table keys name one model each. A key prices a model whose id is the key, the key followed by a date (`-20250929`,
`-2025-08-07` or `@20250929`), or either after one `<provider>/` prefix: `claude-sonnet-4-5` prices
`claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929`, `claude-sonnet-4-5@20250929` and `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5`. Any other ending
names another model, so `gpt-5` prices none of `gpt-5.7`, `gpt-5-codex` or `gpt-5-mini`, and `o1` does not price
`o1-mini`. Among the keys an id matches, the id itself wins, then the id without its date, then both without
the prefix.

399.content:
`fallback` keys are family aliases, used only when no table key matches: a model takes the longest fallback key its
id contains, the first given among equally long keys, so `opus` prices `claude-opus-4-9` and `gpt-5` prices
`gpt-5.7`.

400.content:
`overrides` are the caller's own rules and, unlike table keys, match by substring: a model takes the longest
override key its id contains, the first given among equally long keys, and that override wins over the table and
the fallback, so `{ opus: … }` reprices both `claude-opus-4-8` and `claude-3-opus`. A partial override takes the
prices it lacks from the price the id has without overrides: over a table with `gpt-4o` and `gpt-4o-2024-05-13`,
`{ "gpt-4o": { input: 1 } }` keeps the dated model's own output price. A partial override of an id without a price
of its own gives no price. An override entry that says nothing about `longContext` keeps the model's own tier, and
one with a `longContext` replaces it. A model that nothing prices has no price. Lookups are cached by model id.

404.content:
The record by model, priced: one part per model of its split, or the whole record as one part. `summarize` and
`costOf` charge records through it. A part's cost follows three rules in order: (1) an amount the part carries
(`costUsd`), such as one the agent logged, wins; (2) otherwise each token count is charged at the model's price;
(3) that amount is multiplied by the record's `pricingMultiplier`. An agent's own amount is what it billed, so the
multiplier does not apply to it. A count the part lacks costs nothing; a part without a model, or with a model that
the pricing does not know, has no cost: absent, never 0.

405.content:
A split replaces the aggregate, never adds to it, and wins over it: when the agent logged an amount for the record
and for every model, the models' amounts are used. The record stays whole only when the agent logged an amount for
it that the split does not divide among every model, because charging the other models at table prices would
replace the agent's amount. An amount from a price table on a split record, as `{ ...record, ...costOf(record,
pricing) }` leaves it, does not keep the record whole: its models are charged again. A part of a split counts the
model calls its share records, not a portion of the record's.

406.content:
The long-context tier prices one request. A `request` record is one; a `turn` or `session` record, and each part
of one, is an aggregate of several calls, whose totals cannot tell how large any single request's context was,
so it bills at the base rates and never at an average — the same limit ccusage's aggregation states for its
summed totals. An aggregate counts as one request only when its own, or a part's, `modelCalls` is 1.

410.content:
Totals of `records` in the window, as presence summarizes its sources: tokens, how many records contributed, and
the sum of the costs that `priceRecord` gives their parts, per group. A group's cost is absent when none of its
parts had a cost; parts without one add their tokens but no dollars. The total adds up the groups, as presence adds
up its sources, and counts each record once. A record split by model (`usageByModel`) adds its split, model by
model, and not its aggregate as well, so a turn of several models counts its tokens once and each model's tokens
land in that model's group.

415.content:
An amount in USD and where it comes from, under the names a `UsageRecord` uses, so `{ ...record, ...cost }` is the
priced record; `priceRecord` gives a record split by model one per model.

416.content: One model's share of a record split by model, or the whole record, with its cost when something prices it.

417.content: Absent, never 0, when the agent logged no amount and the pricing does not know the model.

418.content: The model of the share, or the record's model; absent when the record names none.

419.content: The model calls the share, or the whole record, counts; absent when it does not say.

420.content: A usage record priced by model.

880.content:
Applies a plan from `planInstall` once. Under the scope's LedgerLock it probes what an earlier holder left pending,
refuses the plan when the ledger moved on since it was built or when any target no longer holds what the plan saw
(nothing is written then), and otherwise runs the steps with the guarantees of `applyLocked`. The lock is released
only after the step in flight finished and its outcome was recorded.

881.content:
Writes into files that agents and other tools share are not compare-and-swap: a writer that does not take the
LedgerLock can still change a file between the re-check and the write, and that change is lost without a trace.

885.content: Drops a plan without applying it; applying it afterwards fails with `PlanStale`.

888.content:
Reports, without changing anything an agent reads: whether the ledger is readable and has unfinished operations,
whether the LedgerLock is free (and what its holder recorded), owned Artifacts that drifted from the ledger or are
broken symlinks, and the command hooks each agent loads (its settings files and every plugin's or extension's hooks
file, plus the other agents' files it runs) that never run (unknown events), use the wrong timeout unit, point at a
missing program whose first word `shell-quote` reads as a certain absolute path, or fire twice for one event: the
same command twice, or, given `markers`, two hooks of one application, such as an old hook in a settings file next
to the plugin that replaced it. Taking the lock to test it creates the lock files in the harness state directory
and nothing else.

891.content: What the scope's ledger records, read without the lock; it may change right after.

896.content:
Plans the installation of a bundle into agents, without writing: renders the bundle with each agent's preferred
strategy (hooks placed so that no event fires twice in an agent that runs another agent's hooks), reads what is on
disk and in the ledger, and checks the plan invariants. A plan with a conflict and no explicit choice fails with
`PlanConflict`, listing the choices that would resolve each. When an earlier change left operations pending, it
takes the LedgerLock long enough to probe and settle them first.

900.content:
Removes what the ledger records for an owner, under one holding of the LedgerLock: plans the removal (an install
plan in which the owner wants nothing) against the ledger read under the lock and applies it at once. Only the
owner's entries go: a file harness created is deleted, a pre-image restored, an entry other owners or agents still
use released, and an Artifact the user changed since is kept and reported. Empty shared configuration files are
deleted only with recorded file-creation provenance; pre-existing files and implicit parent directories stay.
With `legacyMarkers`, what older versions
of the owner left without a ledger is removed as well. Nothing is written at a path a dotfiles manager owns or
through a symlink; such steps are notes of the plan.

904.content:
Compares the owner's Artifacts on disk with the ledger and, given the bundle, with what it wants, the way chezmoi
does (see `verifyOwner`). Reading needs no lock; only when the ledger is behind the disk does verify take the
LedgerLock, compare again under it and record the disk's hash (`acknowledge`).

930.content:
Path convention, the same for `InstallTarget.roots`: absolute and normalized, with every directory above the
Artifact resolved by realpath and the Artifact's own last segment not followed (`realpath(dirname) + "/" +
basename`). Two spellings of one file are then one locator, and a symlink at the Artifact itself stays visible: the
application reports it as `ObservedArtifact.symlinkTarget`, and a step that would write or delete through it is a
`symlinked-target` conflict, because an atomic write replaces the link with a regular file.

For a json-entry or toml-entry that is an element of the array at `pointer`: the element's identity, such as a

1178.content:
The fallback repository for platforms without SQLite: one JSON record per key, `<key>.lease.json`, replaced with
`writeAtomic`. Every `save` holds the key's guard (`<key>.lease.guard`) while it reads, compares and writes, and
reports `busy` when the guard stays held longer than a second; `fence` holds `<key>.lease.fence`. Both are process
locks, so without SQLite they are lock files whose dead holders are reclaimed one reclaimer at a time, with the
gaps `acquireProcessLock` documents. A record with an unknown `schemaVersion` or shape is refused and never
overwritten.

1181.content:
A repository for one process, such as tests or a host whose leases never cross a process boundary. Each Layer
build starts empty.

1183.content:
The lease repository for one machine: one row per key in a SQLite database. `save` runs in a `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`
transaction, which takes SQLite's write lock (an fcntl lock) before reading the revision, so processes sharing the
file compare and write atomically. The lock is released when its process exits, so neither a crashed writer nor a
reused pid can leave the repository stuck. Fails to build with `unavailable` when the platform has no SQLite, and
with `unsupported-schema` for a database written by a newer version.

1186.content: The lease repository port; `sqliteLeaseRepository`, `fileLeaseRepository` and `memoryLeaseRepository` provide it.

1191.content:
The process that holds a lease, with the same shape as the Platform's `ProcessIdentity`. The start time tells a
reused pid apart from the holder; the boot id tells a process of an earlier boot apart.

1192.content: A lease duration is out of range, or the heartbeat does not fit twice into the TTL.

1193.content: A held lease. It belongs to the Scope `acquire` ran in: closing the Scope stops the heartbeat and releases it.

1194.content:
Fails with `LeaseLost` once the heartbeat finds the lease taken over, released or missing, or cannot confirm a
renewal within the TTL; it never succeeds. Race other work against it to stop that work on loss.

1195.content:
Runs `work` under the repository's per-key fence, after re-reading that this acquisition still holds the lease, and
passes it the fencing token for the writes it makes. Waiting for the fence stops when the lease is lost. When the
lease is lost while `work` runs, `work` is interrupted and the result fails with `LeaseLost`.

1196.content:
The fence is released when `work`'s fiber has ended, so a successor's fenced work starts only after that. An
interrupted fiber ends at once, though, while a Promise it started (`Effect.tryPromise`) keeps running: put a
write that cannot be cancelled in `Effect.uninterruptible`, which keeps the fence until the write settles, or pass
it the AbortSignal `tryPromise` provides and settle only after the write has stopped. A resource that can compare
atomically should also store the highest generation per token key and reject smaller generations in that write.

renewal could be confirmed within the TTL.

1290.content:
A single-instance lock on `path`, which must be in an existing local directory (not NFS). With `platform.sqlite`,
`path` is a SQLite database held with `locking_mode=EXCLUSIVE`: the kernel releases it when the process exits or
crashes, at once, and nothing is ever reclaimed. The holder's identity goes into `<path>.holder` for diagnostics
only, so a process that cannot read its own identity (`platform.process.self` throws: always on win32, which is not
supported, and on darwin in a sandbox that denies running `ps` or `sysctl`) still takes the lock: its `holder` is
`undefined`, and instead of writing `<path>.holder` it removes one that a dead holder left. Without SQLite, `path` is
a lock file that holds the identity itself; a lock file whose holder died is reclaimed on the next attempt, which
needs the holder on this host (see `tryFileLock` for the remaining gaps). The lock file cannot go without the
identity: the call rejects with the error reading it, and takes nothing.

1291.content:
Acquisitions of one lock in this process take turns in memory (see `takeTurn`): while one holds the lock or is
attempting it, the next waits for it to release the lock or give up, then makes its own attempt, so none of them
blocks the thread in a SQLite busy wait on a holder in this process. Without `wait`, a call that finds the turn taken
resolves to `ProcessLockHeld` at once, without attempting, with the holder read from the lock's record.

1301.content:
Whether another process, or an acquisition in this one, holds the process lock on `path`, checked without taking
it: the check writes nothing (no `<path>.holder`, and a missing lock file stays missing and reads as free). The
answer may be stale by the time it arrives, so it can choose between handing work to the holder and starting one,
but it does not replace acquiring. The check never waits, so `signal` is consulted once, before it starts: an
aborted signal rejects with `signal.reason` without touching the lock file.

1302.content:
With `platform.sqlite` it makes one attempt at a shared lock on the database, with no busy timeout and no retries,
and never reads the process identity; checks running at once do not see each other as holders. The first attempt of
an `acquireProcessLock` running at the same moment still gets a free lock; the later retries of `wait: true` can
find it busy while a check reads it, and get it one backoff later. Without SQLite it reads the lock file and judges
its holder as `acquireProcessLock` does, which reads the process identity, and leaves a dead holder's file for the
next acquisition to reclaim.

1303.content: A held process lock. Releasing it is the caller's job; the lock also ends when the process exits.

1304.content:
Who took the lock, as recorded for diagnostics. `undefined` only with `sqlite`, when this process could not read its
own identity (see `acquireProcessLock`).

1639.content:
An in-memory Platform for tests. Paths are normalized (`//`, `.`, `..` and a trailing `/`); there are no special
files or symlinks, so `followSymlinks` changes nothing. `list` rejects for a missing path or a file; writing a file

empty directory, and needs the target's parent). Stored bytes are copied on the way in and out. `process.run`
runs a seeded program only while its file exists, refuses a `.cmd` or `.bat` file on Windows as Node does, honors
`timeoutMs` and `signal`, and passes the platform's `env` unless the run gives one. Errors carry Node's `code`
(`ENOENT`, `EACCES`, `EEXIST`, `EISDIR`, `ENOTDIR`, `ENOTEMPTY`, `EINVAL`), as the Node platform's do.

1745.content:
Input tokens that were neither read from nor written to a cache: `inputTokens − cacheReadTokens −
cacheWriteTokens`, the base-rate input of a price table. A missing cache count is taken as 0; without
`inputTokens` the result is unknown.

1748.content:
Scans the usage of every source `listUsageSources` finds, continuing each from its cursor in `state`, so a scan that
runs again reads only what was written since. A source last written more than 30 minutes ago, as its decode finds it,
is decoded with `final`, so a running session's last requests are reported at the latest 30 minutes after it went
quiet.

1749.content:
A record counts once in the window, by a key its agent's rules give (`UsageDecoder.usageKey`): Claude Code's subagent
files repeat requests, Gemini CLI migrates an older chat into a `.jsonl` file, and a source rewritten under its cursor
(`SourceChanged`) is read again from its start. Claude Code's key is its request id, unique everywhere; the other
agents' keys hold the session, because their ids are unique only within it. A record without a key (an older Codex
`token_count`) is left out of a source read again up to the latest such record read from it, by time and by count
at that time.

1750.content:
Once the loop has run to its end, a source that this scan did not find is dropped when its modification time is
before `since`, or when the listing of the root or directory that held it did not fail.

1754.content:
Where one CodingAgent keeps its usage and how to decode it; the shell supplies built-in decoders. The
use cases select decoders from that table. Provider implementations use this interface.

1755.content: This agent's home rule, used instead of catalog's; required for an agent catalog has no rule for.

1756.content: Decodes one source, from its start or from `options.from`. `until` is the use case's.

1761.content: The sources under the agent's home. A missing root or an unreadable directory is a failure item.

1766.content:
The key under which `scanUsage` counts a record once in its window, unique within the scope where the agent's
files repeat records; `undefined` for a record without one.

1769.content: The part of Platform that decoding usage uses: file reads, and SQLite for an agent that keeps a database.

1772.content:
Usage of one agent, session and source location, in the convention of `Usage`. A count, cost or field the log does
not record is absent, never 0.

1773.content: The subagent lane that made the calls; absent for the main agent.

1775.content: How many model calls a `turn` or `session` record covers.

1776.content: A price factor the request was billed with, such as 2 for a priority service tier. Absent means 1.

1777.content: gen_ai.provider.name, when the agent records it.

1778.content: The agent's id of the model request. With `responseId`, it identifies a request that several files repeat.

1780.content: The record the usage was read from; for a request written as several records, the first one.

1781.content: Epoch milliseconds of the request, or of the end of the aggregate.

1782.content: The same usage split by model. A total takes `usage` or this split, never both added together.

1783.content: Agents to scan, by id or alias; defaults to every agent with a usage decoder.

1784.content: Stops each source at its first record at or after this time.

1897.content:
Reads every file of a session into one Transcript. Expected failures are values: `SessionNotFound`,
`CapabilityUnsupported` (the named agent has no adapter), `NoAdapterAccepted` (detection found none),
`UnknownFormatGeneration` and `ReadFailed`. An abort rejects with `signal.reason`; only defects throw.

1902.content:
The adapter's own summary pass when it has one, else `foldTranscript` of the loaded transcript — the same numbers
either way, so a cache of summaries cannot tell them apart. With `prompts`, the summary also carries the main
lane's user prompts: from the pass for an adapter that implements one, else from the loaded transcript, always by
the kit's prompt rule (`sessionPrompts`).

1907.content: One agent's execution line in a Session. The main agent has no `parentId`; a subagent names its parent lane.

1908.content: The `tool_call` or `system` event on the parent lane that started this subagent, when the log records it.

1909.content: This lane's own system prompt, when the agent records one per lane.

1910.content: Called with the running total of bytes read across the session's files.

1913.content:
A `system` event with `type: 'prompt_snapshot'`: the system prompt and tool definitions the agent recorded at
that point on the event's lane. A later snapshot on the same lane replaces an earlier one; a field left out was
not recorded by that snapshot. `promptSnapshot` returns it for such an event.

1920.content:
Numbers about one Session. A number whose capability the transcript does not list is absent; `failedTools` and
`turns` are always counted.

1921.content: Input tokens of each request in order, downsampled to at most 120 points.

1922.content: A session to read. Without an `agent` (or with an id that does not parse), every adapter's `detect` decides.

1923.content: Where an event's original record is: reading `length` bytes at `offset` of `file` returns it.

1925.content: The ordered events of a Session, merged from all its files, with the records that became no event.

1926.content: The agent version the log records.

1927.content: What these files record: a subset of the adapter's capabilities.

1928.content:
The payload type of each event kind. Code generic over the kind, such as a function that builds a
`TranscriptEventOf<K>`, types its payload as `TranscriptEventPayloads[K]`: while `K` is a type parameter, TypeScript
does not resolve `TranscriptEventOf<K>['payload']`, so an event built from such a payload does not check as a
`TranscriptEventOf<K>`.

1929.content: The main lane's latest recorded system prompt.

1930.content: The main lane's latest recorded tool definitions.

1931.content: What an agent's logs can record. A count whose capability a transcript does not list is absent, never 0.

1933.content:
One event of a Transcript. Events form a flat list and reference each other by id: `agentId` names a lane in
`Transcript.agents`, `parentId` the event this one follows in the agent's own record chain, `requestId` the
`request` event of the model request that produced it, `payload.callId` pairs a `tool_result` with its
`tool_call`, and `shadowedBy` names the compaction that removed it from the model's context. The union is
discriminated by `kind`: narrowing on it types `payload` as that kind's `*Payload`. An agent may add fields of its
own to a payload, which read as `unknown`.

1934.content:
The events of the kinds in `K`, such as `TranscriptEventOf<'tool_call'>`; a union of kinds gives a union of
events, each with its own payload type.

1936.content:
Version of the summary numbers. It changes when a number changes meaning or value for the same files, so that a
cache of summaries knows to recompute them.

2011.content: 用你自己的价格表，或内置的 LiteLLM 价格快照，给用量记录计价。

2018.content: `/cost` 按调用方传入的价格表给用量记录计价，单位是每百万 Token 的美元价格。价格表可以是你自己的，也可以是 `/cost/prices` 提供的 LiteLLM 快照。它是纯计算，不导入任何模块，任何环境都可以运行。

2020.content: 记录里已有 Agent 记下的金额时，`summarize` 直接使用该金额（Pi、opencode、Grok）。否则按模型价格给每一项计数计价，计数包括不含缓存的输入、缓存读取、5 分钟缓存写入、1 小时缓存写入和输出，再乘以记录的 `pricingMultiplier`。Codex 的优先层级为 2。

2021.content: 键的匹配不区分大小写。

2022.content: **价格表的键**各自只对应一个模型。一个键可以匹配这个 id 本身、id 加日期后缀（`-20250929`、`-2025-08-07`，或 Vertex AI 的 `@20250929`），以及它们加一个 `<provider>/` 前缀的形式。因此 `claude-sonnet-4-5` 可以给 `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` 和 `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5` 计价。其他后缀都视为另一个模型，所以 `gpt-5` 既不匹配 `gpt-5.7`，也不匹配 `gpt-5-codex`。

2023.content: **`fallback`** 存放系列别名，例如 `opus`：没有任何键匹配的 id，使用它所包含的最长别名。

2024.content: **`overrides`** 是你自己的规则。与价格表的键不同，它按子串匹配：id 使用它所包含的最长 override 键，该 override 覆盖价格表和 fallback 的价格，可以只覆盖一部分。因此 `{ opus: … }` 会同时改动 `claude-opus-4-8` 和 `claude-3-opus` 的价格，`{ "gpt-4o": … }` 也会作用到 `gpt-4o-mini`。

2025.content: 只覆盖部分价格的 override，缺少的价格取自这个 id 在不加 override 时的价格。以快照为例，`{ "gpt-4o": { input: 1 } }` 给 `gpt-4o-2024-05-13` 计价时，输出价格用它自己的 15 美元，而不是 `gpt-4o` 的 10 美元；本身没有价格的 id 仍然不计价。

2026.content: 没有价格的模型没有费用，结果是 `undefined`，不是 0。汇总中没有任何一项被计价时，`costUsd` 缺失。按模型拆开的 Grok 回合，按模型分别计价和分组。

2027.content: 记录来自 Token 用量。日志里有 Agent 自己记下的费用时，记录带 `costUsd` 和 `costSource: "agent"`；Codex 的优先层级还带 `pricingMultiplier`。

2028.content: `priceRecord(record, pricing): PricedRecord` 按同样的规则给单条记录计价，适合需要自行分桶（例如按小时汇总）的宿主。

2029.content: 返回 `{ parts }`：记录按模型拆分（`usageByModel`）时，每个模型一个 part；否则整条记录一个 part。

2030.content: 每个 part 包含 `model`（记录没有模型名时缺失）、`usage`、计数时的 `modelCalls`，以及 `cost`：`{ costUsd, costSource }`。Agent 记下的金额，`costSource` 为 `"agent"`；按价格表算出的金额为 `"pricing-table"`。

2031.content: 无法计价的 part 没有 `cost`，这不等于费用为 0。把各 part 的费用按 Agent 和模型相加，就是 `summarize` 的分组结果。

2032.content: 拆分后的 part 只带它所属模型那一份的 `modelCalls`，不带整条记录的值；那一份没有计数时，part 就没有 `modelCalls`，所以各 part 加起来可能少于 `record.modelCalls`。按记录统计调用次数的宿主应读取 `record.modelCalls`，自行决定如何分给各模型。

2033.content: `/cost/prices` 是工具包内置的 LiteLLM 模型价格表快照，覆盖内置 Agent 会记录的模型。`litellmPrices` 是可以直接传给 `createPricing` 的价格表。`litellmPricesVersion` 的格式是 `<日期>+<commit>`，表示生成快照时所用的 LiteLLM 文件的日期（UTC）和 commit。把它和算出的费用一起保存，就能知道费用是按哪一版价格表算的。这个入口不导入任何模块，并且与 `/cost` 分开，自带价格表的宿主不会加载它。

2034.content: 快照只保留 Agent 直接调用其 API 的那些服务商的对话模型：Anthropic、OpenAI、Google Gemini、xAI、DeepSeek、Z.ai、Moonshot 和 MiniMax。键使用 LiteLLM 的模型名，并去掉服务商自己的前缀（写作 `grok-4.20`，而不是 `xai/grok-4.20`），因为 Agent 记录的就是不带前缀的名字；经由云平台和网关转发的同一批模型（`bedrock/…`、`vertex_ai/…`、`openrouter/…`）不收录。每个条目包含 LiteLLM 列出的输入、输出、缓存写入、1 小时缓存写入和缓存读取价格。每周一，一个 workflow 会在快照收录的价格发生变化时发起 PR，变化随下一次发布生效。

2035.content: 每个键只对应一个模型，所以快照里没有对应键的 id 就没有价格，不会借用其他模型的价格：在快照收录 `gpt-5.7` 之前，它不计价，也不会按 `gpt-5` 计价。想给这类 id 估价的宿主，可以在 `fallback` 里传入系列别名和自定的价格，或者用 `overrides` 直接给这些 id 定价。override 仍然按子串匹配，因为它由宿主自己编写：键为 `gpt-5` 的完整 override 会给 `gpt-5.7` 计价，并改动快照中所有 id 含 `gpt-5` 的模型的价格；只覆盖部分价格的 override 会改动这些模型，但 `gpt-5.7` 本身没有价格可补，仍然不计价。

2037.content: detectAgents 报告 runnable、found、missing 或 unknown，并附证据与登录状态。

2041.content: `@rivus/agent-kit/discovery` 导出 `detectAgents`、`versionFromOutput` 和 `ProbeRecipe`。它可以在任何环境运行，需要平台。

2043.content: 默认情况下，登录状态只来自凭据文件和环境变量。探测不运行任何命令，也不返回密钥值。`authProbe: "commands"` 还会运行 Agent 自己的状态命令。每条配方列出这些命令的副作用。

2069.content: 改变这些事实会影响使用内置配方的 `detectAgents` 调用方，包括 agent-presence，以及应用的安装与检测界面。没有命令、可识别的应用程序，也没有 Agent 自己的状态时，机器现在报告 `missing`。只有 `~/.claude.json` 的 Claude Code 也是如此：macOS 钥匙串已登录，但还没有会话。只被 hook 或 MCP 设置填满的机器同样报告 `missing`。没有 CLI 时，Cursor 的桌面状态仍然可以确立 `found`。命令与应用程序路径的检测、自定义配方，以及证据和状态接口保持不变。

2070.content: 要定制内置配方，取出它的 `discovery` 服务，并传入 `providers`。见 Provider。用 `/testing` 的 `probeRecipeConformance` 检查自己写的配方。

2072.content: PlatformService 与 NodePlatformLive 返回 Effect，工具包自己不运行。

2076.content: Effect 入口返回从 `PlatformService` 读取平台的 Effect 和 Layer。由应用提供 Layer，并自己运行程序。工具包没有 Promise 包装，也不运行 Effect。

2077.content: `@rivus/agent-kit/platform/effect` 导出 `PlatformService`，也就是作为 Effect 服务的 `Platform`。任何环境都可以用，需要 `effect`。

2078.content: `@rivus/agent-kit/node/effect` 导出 `NodePlatformLive`。它是用 `createNodePlatform()` 提供 `PlatformService` 的 Layer，只在 Node 里运行，需要 `effect`。

2079.content: 换一份 `env` 或 `home` 时，改为提供 `Layer.succeed(PlatformService, createNodePlatform({ env, home }))`。

2080.content: `effect` 必须与 `peerDependencies.effect` 完全一致。见 安装。普通入口不会加载上述可选 peer。

2081.content: 其他 Effect 入口是 Harness 安装、ACP、租约 和 车道。

2083.content: planInstall 与 applyInstall 写入 hook 和 skill，并记入账本。

2084.content: 每个 Agent 写到哪里

2087.content: `/harness` 把应用需要的内容装进 Agent。目前是 hook 和 skill，也可以再卸掉。任何环境都可以用，需要 `effect` 和平台。

2089.content: 它先做计划。只有应用计划时，才会改 Agent 目标。`InstallPlan` 是无法构造、也无法序列化的句柄。`applyInstall` 只接受 `planInstall` 返回的计划。否则以 `code` 为 `"unknown-plan"` 的 `AgentKitError` 终止。因此重启后要重新计划。持有 SQLite 锁期间，每一次目标变更都记入 `$XDG_STATE_HOME/agent-kit/harness` 下的账本。崩溃靠探测恢复，而不是重放。

2090.content: Claude Code 写入一个 skills 目录插件。

2091.content: Codex 写入一个插件。`codex` 在 `PATH` 上时走 `codex plugin`。否则通过 `config.toml` 的 hook 组写入。

2092.content: Gemini CLI 写入一个扩展。

2093.content: Grok 在 `~/.grok/hooks` 里写入一个文件。

2094.content: Cursor 写入一个本地插件。

2095.content: opencode 和 Pi 写入一座桥，把它们的事件转发给命令。

2096.content: 方言读作结束某事的事件（阶段 `finish`）同步送达。这些事件是 opencode 的 `session.idle`、`session.error`、`session.deleted`，以及空闲时的 `session.status`，还有 Pi 的 `agent_end`、`agent_settled` 和 `session_shutdown`。桥把它们交给命令，并等待它退出，最多 5 秒。因此结束事件会在下一个事件转发之前到达命令。

2097.content: 发送失败或超时仍然不会向 Agent 抛出。其他事件转发时不等待。超时会杀掉桥启动的 shell，因此更长的结束 hook 会被截断。同一拍里刚好在结束之前转发的活动事件，仍可能在结束之后到达命令。

2098.content: opencode 桥按 opencode 发出的样子转发每条总线事件，并加上插件的 `directory`。工具 hook 则是 `{ type, properties, directory }`。

2099.content: `file.edited` 这类事件没有指名会话时，桥加上 `currentSessionId`。它是该插件实例见过的、最近一条指名了会话的事件所属的会话。那条事件有没有被转发都算。会话被删除后不再使用。一个目录里有多个会话时，取最近的那一个。

2100.content: 读取过程中抛出的载荷不会拒绝插件回调。`readHookEvent` 在 opencode 自己的会话路径之后读取 `currentSessionId`。指名了会话的事件保留该 id。

2101.content: 即使 Agent 也会运行 Claude Code 的设置 hook，一条事件也只触发一次。

2102.content: 共享文件保留原有注释和格式。不通过符号链接写入，也不写入 chezmoi 管理的文件。没有取得账本锁的工具如果同时编辑，改动可能丢失，而且不留痕迹。

2103.content: 计划句柄不能序列化后交给后来的进程应用。重启之后，或遇到 `PlanStale`、`TargetChanged` 之后，要重新计划。

2104.content: 计划过程可能在账本锁下了结先前持有者尚未完成的操作。`verify` 可能确认一份落后于磁盘的账本。`doctor` 的锁检查可能在 harness 状态目录里创建锁文件。这些都不会改写 Agent 目标。

2105.content: `uninstall("my-app")` 只移除账本记录的内容，并保留用户改过的文件。

2106.content: Hook 载荷本身用 Hook 事件 读取。安装创建的路径不是发现证据。见 Agent 检测。

2108.content: readHookEvent 把 hook 载荷变成生命周期阶段，并且不做 IO。

2112.content: `/harness/events` 给 hook 进程使用。它是同步的，不做 IO，也不导入 npm 包或 Node 内置模块。任何环境都可以运行。

2114.content: Agent 表 中的每个 Agent 在 `/harness/events` 里都有 hook 方言。Hook 命令继续使用 `builtinHookDialects`。这份隔离构建不导入任何模块，并持有单独的 hook 对象。它不跟随 `providers` 列表。

2115.content: `agent` 是真正运行该 hook 的 Agent。Grok 和 Cursor 也会运行 Claude Code 设置里的 hook。

2116.content: `phase` 为 `start`、`activity`、`blocked`、`finish` 或 `unknown`。Agent 提供更多信息时，还带 `scope`、`outcome` 和 `blocker`。方言不认识的载荷或事件读作 `unknown`，不会抛出。`readHookEvent` 不会因为载荷而抛出。

2117.content: 工具参数从不复制，只保留工具名和调用 id。

2118.content: `terminal` 标出 hook 所在的 herdr、cmux、Superset 或 tmux 窗格。

2119.content: 只在不是权限门的事件上注册观察 hook，或者返回该事件输出规则所记录的允许响应。观察者打印事件的 `passThrough`。这是方言的值，除非该事件的 `output` 覆盖它。例如 Cursor 的 `beforeSubmitPrompt` 打印 `{"continue":true}`。观察者不得静默挡住一道门。

2120.content: 每个门的 `output` 规则决定退出码和 stdout 做什么。Cursor 的门会挡住无法读取的输出。空输出在那里做什么，没有文档记载。

2121.content: `builtinHookDialects` 保存每个 Agent 的 hook 事实：事件名、超时单位、哪些事件是权限门，以及观察 hook 应该打印什么。

2122.content: 在 `readHookEvent` 中指定没有 hook 方言的 Agent，会抛出 `code: "capability-unsupported"` 的 `AgentKitError`。用 `/catalog` 的 `isAgentKitError` 检测。

2123.content: 安装这些 hook 见 Harness 安装。用 `/testing` 的 `hookDialectConformance` 检查自己写的方言。

2125.content: redact 与 redactText 隐藏主目录路径和形如密钥的字符串。

2130.content: 二者隐藏主目录路径的各种写法，以及形如密钥的字符串。

2131.content: 任何环境都可以用，也不导入其他包。README 没有再说明选项或返回值。

2133.content: listSessions 读取文件头尾，loadTranscript 读取一个会话。

2139.content: `@rivus/agent-kit/sessions` 导出 `listSessions`、`sessionAdapterHome`、`isSessionHead` 和 `SessionAdapter`。任何环境都可以用，需要平台。

2140.content: `@rivus/agent-kit/transcript` 导出 `loadTranscript`、`summarizeSession`、`Transcript` 和 `TranscriptEvent`。任何环境都可以用，需要平台。

2141.content: `listSessions` 只读取每个文件的头和尾。根目录缺失时产出 `{ ref, error }`，`error` 为 `RootMissing`。文件读不了时同样产出，`error` 为 `ReadFailed`。然后继续下一项。在 `listSessions({ agents })` 中指定没有会话适配器的 Agent，会抛出 `code: "capability-unsupported"` 的 `AgentKitError`。

2142.content: `loadTranscript` 读取一个会话的每个文件，返回有序的 `events`、子 Agent lane（`agents`），以及跳过的记录。返回的是完整会话。没有跟随文件实时更新的 API。压缩只有在整个会话读完之后，才用 `shadowedBy` 标出被替换的事件。

2143.content: Agent 自带有界摘要过程时，`summarizeSession` 读取该过程。否则它折叠已经加载的 transcript。两种做法得到的数字相同。占用的内存随会话的请求数、lane 数和工具调用数增长，不随文件字节数增长。

2144.content: 它接受 `prompts: { limit, maxChars }`，并在同一次读取里返回主 lane 的用户提示词。

2145.content: 一条记录的提示词文本只拼接它自己的文本块，不包含宿主加在旁边的文本。图像块属于用户自己。

2146.content: 每个块都会去掉首尾空白，块与块之间空一行。

2147.content: 所有块都是宿主添加文本的记录算作注入，不计回合。

2148.content: 自己的文本只有空白的记录计一个回合，但没有提示词。

2149.content: 按 transcript 顺序返回前 `limit` 条记录，每条截到 `maxChars`。

2150.content: 上限不是范围内的整数时，抛出 `code: "invalid-prompts"` 的 `AgentKitError`。

2151.content: 事件的 `kind` 决定 `payload` 的类型。`event.kind === "tool_call"` 之后，`event.payload` 是 `TranscriptEventPayloads["tool_call"]`。Agent 在该 kind 的载荷类型之外添加的字段读作 `unknown`。

2152.content: 事件通过 `agentId`、`parentId`、`requestId`、`payload.callId` 和 `shadowedBy` 互相引用。

2153.content: 这些事件上的 Token 计数遵循用量约定。日志没有记录的计数是缺失，不是 0。

2154.content: `sessionAdapterHome` 解析会话服务或用量服务的主目录。直接解码用量时这样调用：`sessionAdapterHome(usage, { home, env })`。见 Token 用量。

2155.content: `loadTranscript` 和 `summarizeSession` 的结果是 `Result`：`{ ok: true, value }` 或 `{ ok: false, error }`。`error._tag` 标出失败原因。失败为 `SessionNotFound`、`ReadFailed`、`UnknownFormatGeneration`、`NoAdapterAccepted` 或 `CapabilityUnsupported`。

2156.content: `signal` 选项中止时，调用以 `signal.reason` 拒绝。

2158.content: scanUsage 读取 Token 记录，不构造 transcript。

2162.content: `/transcript/usage` 解码 Token 用量，不构造 transcript。它不导入包以外的模块，因此装不上依赖的宿主也可以单独打包它。任何环境都可以用，需要平台。

2164.content: `/transcript/usage` 读取 Agent 表 中除 Cursor 以外每个 Agent 的用量。

2165.content: `scanUsage` 读取每个 Agent 主目录下的用量，并返回一份状态，供下一次扫描使用。下一次扫描只读取此后写入的内容。

2166.content: 调用方如果保留状态，还要在旁边保留自己的合计。同一个 `since` 窗口只用一份状态，并且一次只跑一次扫描。从同一份状态并发跑两次，两次都会产出新记录。计数遵循用量约定。

2167.content: 一条 `UsageRecord` 是一次模型请求（`granularity: "request"`）。Agent 只记录回合合计时，它是一个回合。Grok 就是这样，并带 `modelCalls` 和 `usageByModel`。

2168.content: 日志里有 Agent 自己的费用时，记录带上 `costUsd` 和 `costSource: "agent"`。Codex 的优先层级还会带上 `pricingMultiplier`。

2169.content: 多个文件持有的同一次请求只计一次。这包括开头复制了另一份记录的 Claude Code 子 Agent 文件，以及迁移进 `.jsonl` 文件的较旧 Gemini CLI 对话。

2170.content: Claude Code 把一次响应写成多条记录。仍在运行的会话，最后几次请求会留在状态里。文件安静 30 分钟后，扫描才报告它们。

2171.content: 从状态继续的扫描需要 `since`。状态为每个来源保留一个游标。Codex 归档之后，身份仍然成立。状态还保留此后每条已计数请求的短哈希。忙碌的一个月大约 1 MB。

2185.content: 空闲 lane 在有空位、且没有人等待时启动。否则它排到队列末尾。已经有 `maxQueued` 条 lane 在等待时，`wake` 以 `LaneQueueFull` 失败。空出来的位置给等待最久的 lane。因此运行期间再次被唤醒的 lane，排在这期间入队的 lane 后面。没有 `maxQueued` 时，队列对每个键最多保留一项。

2186.content: `cancel(key)` 丢掉该键尚欠的唤醒，中断它正在运行的激活，并在激活结束（包括它的终结器和 `onExit`）后返回。`close` 以 `LanesClosed` 拒绝后来的唤醒，丢掉队列，中断每个正在运行的激活并等待它们。关闭创建这些 lane 的 Scope 会执行 `close`。

2187.content: 激活带着 `createLanes` 运行时的上下文运行。它结束时关闭自己的 Scope，lane 只在那之后继续。被中断的激活，其终结器会在任何键的下一个激活取得它的位置之前运行完。

2188.content: `onExit` 报告每个激活如何结束。激活自己成功或失败时，即使取消、关闭或超时发生在它的 Scope 关闭期间，也会如此报告。`ActivationInterrupted` 表示 lane 截断了它，或在它开始前停掉了它。后一种情况下从未调用 `activate`。`onExit` 不可中断地运行，因此 `cancel` 和 `close` 会等它。它不得反过来等它们。它抛出的缺陷记为一条警告。

2202.content: `runFenced` 持有仓储的按键 fence，并在工作开始前重新读取记录。等待 fence 会在 lease 丢失时停止。工作的 fiber 结束时释放 fence，因此后继者的 fenced 工作在那之后才开始。被中断的 fiber 立刻结束，但它启动的 Promise 继续运行。无法取消的写入放进 `Effect.uninterruptible`，fence 会等它落定。也可以把 `Effect.tryPromise` 提供的 AbortSignal 传给写入，让它只在写入停止后才落定。

2215.content: 有 `platform.sqlite` 时，锁是以 `locking_mode=EXCLUSIVE` 持有的 SQLite 数据库。持有者退出或崩溃的瞬间，内核就放下它，没有东西需要回收。持有者身份只为诊断写入 `<path>.holder`。因此读不到自己身份的进程仍然可以取得锁。例如 macOS 沙箱拒绝运行 `ps` 或 `sysctl`，使 `platform.process.self` 抛出。此时 `lock.value.holder` 为 `undefined`，不写入 `<path>.holder`。已死持有者留下的那份会被删除。

2216.content: 没有 SQLite 时，锁是一份保存身份的文件。持有者死在本机上的锁文件，会在下一次尝试时回收，一次只有一个回收者。锁文件需要身份才能判断持有者。因此那里的 `acquireProcessLock` 以读取身份的错误拒绝，并且什么都不创建。

2217.content: 锁文件回退有两个限制：

2218.content: 在创建锁文件和写入戳记之间崩溃，会留下一个空文件。它在 30 秒内算作已持有。

2219.content: 持有者在这两步之间停顿超过这段时间，可能和它的回收者一起持有这把锁。

2220.content: 传入 `{ wait: true, signal }` 可以等待持有者，而不是立刻得到 `ProcessLockHeld`。

2221.content: 在 win32 上，平台无法识别进程（boot id、pid 和启动时间）。SQLite 进程锁仍然可以取得，此时 `holder` 为 `undefined`。NFS、容器和被改名的主机见 安装。

2222.content: 同一把锁在一个进程内的取得按内存中的轮次进行。因此可以从许多并发任务取得锁，而不必自己排队。一个任务持有锁或正在尝试时，下一个任务等它释放或放弃，然后才做自己的尝试。它从不对本进程里的持有者打开 SQLite。否则持有者完成并释放所需要的线程会被忙等堵住。

2223.content: 没有 `wait` 时，这样的调用立刻得到 `ProcessLockHeld`。中止 `signal` 会把任务移出队列。其他任务的轮次保持原样。

2224.content: 任务通过具有同一个 `sqlite` 对象的平台指名同一个文件时，共享这些轮次。没有 SQLite 时，则是同一个 `fs`。文件的目录会经符号链接解析。`createNodePlatform` 给出的每个平台都是这样。其他进程仍由 SQLite 或锁文件挡在外面。

2225.content: 轮次活在 `@rivus/agent-kit-collab` 的模块状态里。因此进程里的第二份副本不与它们共享。第二份副本可以是另一个版本，或打进某个依赖的一份。它会像另一个进程那样在 SQLite 里相遇。

2226.content: `isProcessLockHeld` 说明另一个进程，或本进程里的一次取得，是否持有这把锁。它自己不取得锁。短命进程可以用它把工作交给正在运行的持有者，只在没有持有者时才启动一个。

2227.content: 这次检查什么都不写，也没有 `<path>.holder`。缺失的锁文件读作空闲，并保持缺失。

2228.content: 有 SQLite 时，它做一次共享锁尝试，没有忙等超时，也没有重试。它不读取进程身份，并在远小于一毫秒内回答。同时运行的检查都会把空闲的锁看成空闲。同一时刻运行的 `acquireProcessLock` 的第一次尝试会等完一次检查（10 毫秒忙等超时，然后几次短重试），仍然得到空闲的锁。`wait: true` 的后续重试没有忙等超时，因此碰上检查的那一次可能发现空闲的锁正忙。这次调用会在另一次退避之后得到它。

2229.content: 没有 SQLite 时，它像一次取得那样判断锁文件的持有者，并把已死持有者的文件留给下一次取得去回收。

2230.content: 答案到达时可能已经过时。因此只有 `acquireProcessLock` 决定谁持有锁。它接受 `{ signal }`。检查从不等待，所以只在开始前看一次信号。若已中止，则以 `signal.reason` 拒绝。

orderedDocs: **`fallback`** 存放系列别名，例如 `opus`：没有任何键匹配的 id，使用它所包含的最长别名。

**`overrides`** 是你自己的规则。与价格表的键不同，它按子串匹配：id 使用它所包含的最长 override 键，该 override 覆盖价格表和 fallback 的价格，可以只覆盖一部分。因此 `{ opus: … }` 会同时改动 `claude-opus-4-8` 和 `claude-3-opus` 的价格，`{ "gpt-4o": … }` 也会作用到 `gpt-4o-mini`。

**价格表的键**各自只对应一个模型。一个键可以匹配这个 id 本身、id 加日期后缀（`-20250929`、`-2025-08-07`，或 Vertex AI 的 `@20250929`），以及它们加一个 `<provider>/` 前缀的形式。因此 `claude-sonnet-4-5` 可以给 `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` 和 `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5` 计价。其他后缀都视为另一个模型，所以 `gpt-5` 既不匹配 `gpt-5.7`，也不匹配 `gpt-5-codex`。

`cancel(key)` 丢掉该键尚欠的唤醒，中断它正在运行的激活，并在激活结束（包括它的终结器和 `onExit`）后返回。`close` 以 `LanesClosed` 拒绝后来的唤醒，丢掉队列，中断每个正在运行的激活并等待它们。关闭创建这些 lane 的 Scope 会执行 `close`。

`command`: the agent runs a command with the payload as JSON on stdin and reads its exit code and stdout.
`plugin`: the agent calls an in-process plugin, which forwards each event's object as the payload.
`connectAgent` 用调用方传入的环境原样启动 Agent 的 ACP 程序，完成握手，并返回一个属于该 Scope 的连接。关闭 Scope 会关闭它的会话并停止进程。

`content-hash`: each new or changed hook definition waits for the user's review, so a command that embeds a
version asks again after every upgrade. `workspace`: hooks run once their folder is trusted, with no per-hook
review.
`detectAgents(platform)` 对 Agent 表 中的每个内置 Agent 报告 `runnable`、`found`、`missing` 或 `unknown`。报告里包含证据、命令打印的版本，以及登录状态。
`detectAgents` 解析为 `Installation[]`。探测失败记在该 Agent 的 `problems` 里。
`effect` 必须与 `peerDependencies.effect` 完全一致。见 安装。普通入口不会加载上述可选 peer。

`fallback` keys are family aliases, used only when no table key matches: a model takes the longest fallback key its
id contains, the first given among equally long keys, so `opus` prices `claude-opus-4-9` and `gpt-5` prices
`gpt-5.7`.
`file.edited` 这类事件没有指名会话时，桥加上 `currentSessionId`。它是该插件实例见过的、最近一条指名了会话的事件所属的会话。那条事件有没有被转发都算。会话被删除后不再使用。一个目录里有多个会话时，取最近的那一个。
`hookDialectConformance` 检查 hook 方言。`probeRecipeConformance` 检查发现配方。描述符如何合并，见 Provider。
`inputTokens` 包含缓存读取和缓存写入。
`isProcessLockHeld` 说明另一个进程，或本进程里的一次取得，是否持有这把锁。它自己不取得锁。短命进程可以用它把工作交给正在运行的持有者，只在没有持有者时才启动一个。

`listSessions` 只读取每个文件的头和尾。根目录缺失时产出 `{ ref, error }`，`error` 为 `RootMissing`。文件读不了时同样产出，`error` 为 `ReadFailed`。然后继续下一项。在 `listSessions({ agents })` 中指定没有会话适配器的 Agent，会抛出 `code: "capability-unsupported"` 的 `AgentKitError`。
`listSessions` 遇到缺失的根（`RootMissing`）或读不了的文件（`ReadFailed`）时，产出 `{ ref, error }`，然后继续下一项。`scanUsage` 同样产出 `{ agent, path, error }`。

`loadTranscript` 和 `summarizeSession` 的结果是 `Result`：`{ ok: true, value }` 或 `{ ok: false, error }`。`error._tag` 标出失败原因。失败为 `SessionNotFound`、`ReadFailed`、`UnknownFormatGeneration`、`NoAdapterAccepted` 或 `CapabilityUnsupported`。

`loadTranscript` 和 `summarizeSession` 解析为 `Result`：`{ ok: true, value }` 或 `{ ok: false, error }`，其中 `error._tag` 标出失败原因。`loadTranscript` 和 `summarizeSession` 的失败为 `SessionNotFound`、`ReadFailed`、`UnknownFormatGeneration`、`NoAdapterAccepted` 或 `CapabilityUnsupported`。
`loadTranscript` 读取一个会话的每个文件，返回有序的 `events`、子 Agent lane（`agents`），以及跳过的记录。返回的是完整会话。没有跟随文件实时更新的 API。压缩只有在整个会话读完之后，才用 `shadowedBy` 标出被替换的事件。

`onExit` 报告每个激活如何结束。激活自己成功或失败时，即使取消、关闭或超时发生在它的 Scope 关闭期间，也会如此报告。`ActivationInterrupted` 表示 lane 截断了它，或在它开始前停掉了它。后一种情况下从未调用 `activate`。`onExit` 不可中断地运行，因此 `cancel` 和 `close` 会等它。它不得反过来等它们。它抛出的缺陷记为一条警告。

`overrides` are the caller's own rules and, unlike table keys, match by substring: a model takes the longest
override key its id contains, the first given among equally long keys, and that override wins over the table and
the fallback, so `{ opus: … }` reprices both `claude-opus-4-8` and `claude-3-opus`. A partial override takes the
prices it lacks from the price the id has without overrides: over a table with `gpt-4o` and `gpt-4o-2024-05-13`,
`{ "gpt-4o": { input: 1 } }` keeps the dated model's own output price. A partial override of an id without a price
of its own gives no price. An override entry that says nothing about `longContext` keeps the model's own tier, and
one with a `longContext` replaces it. A model that nothing prices has no price. Lookups are cached by model id.

`runFenced` 持有仓储的按键 fence，并在工作开始前重新读取记录。等待 fence 会在 lease 丢失时停止。工作的 fiber 结束时释放 fence，因此后继者的 fenced 工作在那之后才开始。被中断的 fiber 立刻结束，但它启动的 Promise 继续运行。无法取消的写入放进 `Effect.uninterruptible`，fence 会等它落定。也可以把 `Effect.tryPromise` 提供的 AbortSignal 传给写入，让它只在写入停止后才落定。

A single-instance lock on `path`, which must be in an existing local directory (not NFS). With `platform.sqlite`,

crashes, at once, and nothing is ever reclaimed. The holder's identity goes into `<path>.holder` for diagnostics
only, so a process that cannot read its own identity (`platform.process.self` throws: always on win32, which is not
supported, and on darwin in a sandbox that denies running `ps` or `sysctl`) still takes the lock: its `holder` is

a lock file that holds the identity itself; a lock file whose holder died is reclaimed on the next attempt, which
needs the holder on this host (see `tryFileLock` for the remaining gaps). The lock file cannot go without the
identity: the call rejects with the error reading it, and takes nothing.

The fallback repository for platforms without SQLite: one JSON record per key, `<key>.lease.json`, replaced with

locks, so without SQLite they are lock files whose dead holders are reclaimed one reclaimer at a time, with the
gaps `acquireProcessLock` documents. A record with an unknown `schemaVersion` or shape is refused and never
overwritten.

write that cannot be cancelled in `Effect.uninterruptible`, which keeps the fence until the write settles, or pass
it the AbortSignal `tryPromise` provides and settle only after the write has stopped. A resource that can compare
atomically should also store the highest generation per token key and reject smaller generations in that write.

The lease repository for one machine: one row per key in a SQLite database. `save` runs in a `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`

reused pid can leave the repository stuck. Fails to build with `unavailable` when the platform has no SQLite, and
with `unsupported-schema` for a database written by a newer version.

or crashes, so the next process takes it at once and probes the pending operations. The holder writes its identity
to `<scope>.lock.holder`, which only diagnostics read. Without `platform.sqlite`, `acquire` fails with
`LedgerLockUnavailable`. Local directories only: fcntl locks are unreliable on NFS.

summed totals. An aggregate counts as one request only when its own, or a part's, `modelCalls` is 1.

multiplier does not apply to it. A count the part lacks costs nothing; a part without a model, or with a model that
the pricing does not know, has no cost: absent, never 0.

Whether another process, or an acquisition in this one, holds the process lock on `path`, checked without taking
it: the check writes nothing (no `<path>.holder`, and a missing lock file stays missing and reads as free). The
answer may be stale by the time it arrives, so it can choose between handing work to the holder and starting one,
but it does not replace acquiring. The check never waits, so `signal` is consulted once, before it starts: an
aborted signal rejects with `signal.reason` without touching the lock file.

With `platform.sqlite` it makes one attempt at a shared lock on the database, with no busy timeout and no retries,
and never reads the process identity; checks running at once do not see each other as holders. The first attempt of
an `acquireProcessLock` running at the same moment still gets a free lock; the later retries of `wait: true` can
find it busy while a check reads it, and get it one backoff later. Without SQLite it reads the lock file and judges
its holder as `acquireProcessLock` does, which reads the process identity, and leaves a dead holder's file for the
next acquisition to reclaim.
Without a version probe, the agent is at most `found`.

Writes into files that agents and other tools share are not compare-and-swap: a writer that does not take the
LedgerLock can still change a file between the re-check and the write, and that change is lost without a trace.

有 `platform.sqlite` 时，锁是以 `locking_mode=EXCLUSIVE` 持有的 SQLite 数据库。持有者退出或崩溃的瞬间，内核就放下它，没有东西需要回收。持有者身份只为诊断写入 `<path>.holder`。因此读不到自己身份的进程仍然可以取得锁。例如 macOS 沙箱拒绝运行 `ps` 或 `sysctl`，使 `platform.process.self` 抛出。此时 `lock.value.holder` 为 `undefined`，不写入 `<path>.holder`。已死持有者留下的那份会被删除。

有 SQLite 时，它做一次共享锁尝试，没有忙等超时，也没有重试。它不读取进程身份，并在远小于一毫秒内回答。同时运行的检查都会把空闲的锁看成空闲。同一时刻运行的 `acquireProcessLock` 的第一次尝试会等完一次检查（10 毫秒忙等超时，然后几次短重试），仍然得到空闲的锁。`wait: true` 的后续重试没有忙等超时，因此碰上检查的那一次可能发现空闲的锁正忙。这次调用会在另一次退避之后得到它。
